unit Shapes

const
    Sides = 4

type
    Color = (Red, Green)

    Box = record
        width: Integer
        color: Color

    Measured = trait
        function size(this): Integer

    Size = 1 .. 10

## The area of `b`.
function area(b: Box): Integer
    if b.width > 0 then
        return b.width * b.width
    return 0

procedure paint(var b: Box)

    b.color := Color.Green
